id: \bBlack: My name is Black. I've dreamed of becoming the Champion of the Unova Pokémon League for nine years, and have always pushed forward.
en: \bBlack: My name is Black. I've dreamed of becoming the Champion of the Unova Pokémon League for nine years, and have always pushed forward.
it: \bBlack: Mi chiamo Black. Sogno di diventare Campione della Lega Pokémon di Unima da nove anni, e sono sempre andato avanti.

id: \bBecause of that I've been given the title Dreamer.
en: \bBecause of that I've been given the title Dreamer.
it: \bPer questo mi è stato conferito il titolo di Sognatore.
